limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses A431 vulval SCC cell line and CAFs; generalizability to other cancer types requires further validation.
In vivo evidence is limited to xenograft models and static patient samples; dynamic heterotypic junction behavior in native tumor microenvironment not assessed.
The role of other cadherins (e.g., P-cadherin) in heterotypic adhesion is not fully explored beyond knockout experiments.
Mechanotransduction downstream signaling pathways beyond α-catenin/vinculin are not investigated.
The contribution of ECM remodeling by CAFs versus direct force transmission is not quantitatively dissected.
The study does not address how heterotypic junctions are regulated in different stromal contexts or during metastasis.
